_comment: Succession register for mission noogram/cosmon#20. APPEND-ONLY. One line per transition: a verdict that has been overtaken, and the verdict that now speaks for the same subject. Entries are never edited and never deleted; a second supersession of the same verdict is a second entry, not a rewrite of the first. Nothing here modifies any verdict — the linkage belongs to the history, not to either verdict. Paths are relative to the fleet molecules root; see verdict-catalogue.jsonl for the same paths with their root and their subject.

subject: g1-behavioural-contract
previous_subject_sha_note: indeterminate — the round-1 gate wave named only the affected release v0.2.2 and left no commit in its verdict, its state or its log; the molecule branch feat/task-20260723-5371 no longer exists. See verdict-inventory.md §4 for what was tried.
next_subject_sha_note: indeterminate — the round-2 contract names its surface (cosmon_transport::readiness + crates/cosmon-cli/src/cmd/tackle.rs) and its trunk (feat/container-worker-doors) but no commit; branch harvested.
